item.title: IIDW 2026 Concludes with Key Discussions on Arbitration, Mediation and Institutional Frameworks
item.description: The fifth and final day of IIDW 2026 brought together judges, senior advocates, academics, practitioners, and international delegates for a series of discussions on arbitration, mediation, and institutional reform, culminating in reflections on India’s evolving role as a trusted seat of dispute resolution. The post IIDW 2026 Concludes with Key Discussions on Arbitration, Mediation and Institutional Frameworks appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Creamy layer status of OBC candidates can’t be decided on parental salary alone: Supreme Court
item.description: “The exclusion of the creamy layer among the backward classes is not a matter of mere policy preference but a constitutional imperative intended to ensure that the benefits of reservation reach those who are socially and educationally backward in the true sense of the phrase.” The post Creamy layer status of OBC candidates can’t be decided on parental salary alone: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Contempt jurisdiction unaffected by merger doctrine: Madras HC directs compliance with Deepathoon lighting orders
item.description: “Before law all are one and no one can claim immunity merely because they happen to hold high offices.” The post Contempt jurisdiction unaffected by merger doctrine: Madras HC directs compliance with Deepathoon lighting orders appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: No automatic Multi-State status after State Bifurcation: Supreme Court explains scope of Section 103 of Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act
item.description: The Supreme Court held that the deeming fiction under Section 103 of the Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002 does not operate automatically merely because a cooperative society’s area temporarily extends across two States following reorganisation. The post No automatic Multi-State status after State Bifurcation: Supreme Court explains scope of Section 103 of Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act appeared first on SCC Times.
